stories.title: Supporting cloudburst victims in Swabi, KPK
stories.summary: Cash assistance for families hit by the devastating cloudburst in Swabi.
body: A devastating cloudburst left many families in Swabi, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, without shelter, food and basic essentials.
The Seekers Club team stepped forward with a cash assistance drive, so that affected families could cover their most urgent needs straight away.
This relief was made possible by our donors and volunteers. Thank you for standing with families when they needed it most.

stories.title: Reaching out to families in Jalalpur Pirwala
stories.summary: Our South Punjab team served cooked meals to underprivileged households.
body: Volunteers from The Seekers Club South Punjab team served cooked meals to underprivileged households in Jalalpur Pirwala, so that no one in the community was left hungry.
Our work in Jalalpur Pirwala is part of a larger mission: to spread kindness, hope and humanity across communities, one act at a time.

stories.title: Cash distribution drive in Mansehra
stories.summary: Our KPK chapter gave direct cash support to families facing hardship.
body: The Seekers Club KPK Chapter organised a cash distribution drive in Mansehra for families facing economic hardship. Families could use the support for food, medicine, clothing or shelter.
The drive was carried out by local volunteers with the support of donors and the wider Seekers Club network.
More than financial help, it carried a simple message to every family: you are not alone, and we stand with you.

stories.title: Tree plantation and cooler distribution drive
stories.summary: Volunteers planted trees and gave water coolers to low-income households ahead of summer.
body: Volunteers, young people and local residents joined The Seekers Club to plant trees across local communities, working towards a greener, cleaner and healthier Pakistan.
Alongside the plantation, we distributed water coolers to low-income households so families could cope with the summer heat.
The drive was about more than planting saplings: it was about growing awareness and a shared sense of responsibility for our environment.

stories.title: Tree plantation drive, South Punjab Chapter
stories.summary: Our South Punjab chapter planted trees in schools, public spaces and community areas.
body: The South Punjab Chapter of The Seekers Club ran a tree plantation drive across schools, public spaces and community areas.
With help from volunteers, youth and local residents, the drive aimed to fight climate change, restore green spaces and leave a better environment for the next generation.

stories.title: Ration bag distribution, Sindh Chapter
stories.summary: Our Sindh chapter delivered ration bags with essential food items to families in need.
body: The Sindh Chapter of The Seekers Club ran a ration bag distribution drive, delivering essential food items to families facing economic hardship in underprivileged communities.
Our volunteers also took time to sit with families and listen to their concerns — a reminder that small acts of kindness can bring great comfort.
